excerpt: The long installation outage began in August 2023 and concluded in April 2024. ... Beam commissioning commenced June 7th and was completed in less than one month. Neutron production for the user program resumed July 11th as planned at 1.3 GeV and 1.7 MW.
title: Completion of the Proton Power Upgrade Project at the Spallation Neutron Source (LINAC2024, THPB045, doi:10.18429/JACoW-LINAC2024-THPB045)
